MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১) The ___ works with the standard Copy and Paste commands.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
The Office Clipboard allows you to copy up to 24 items from Office documents or other programs and paste them into another Office document.
For example, you can copy text from an email message, data from a workbook or datasheet,
and a graphic from a presentation, and then paste them all into a document.
By using the Office Clipboard, you can arrange the copied items the way that you want in the document.
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২) When sending an email, CC stands for Carbon Copy and BCC stands for?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
BCC(Blind carbon copy)
Meaning: a copy of a message (such as an e-mail) that is sent without the knowledge of the other recipients.
For security and privacy reasons, it is best to use the Blind Carbon Copy (BCC) feature when sending an email message to a large number of people.
When you place email addresses in the BCC field of a message, those addresses are invisible to the recipients of the email.;
Conversely, any email addresses that you place in the To field or the CC field are visible to everyone who receives the message.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৩) The Internet was originally a project of which agency?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
The first workable prototype of the Internet came in the late 1960s with the creation of ARPANET,
or the Advanced Research Projects Agency Network.
Originally funded by the U.S. Department of Defense, ARPANET used packet switching to allow multiple computers to communicate on a single network.
Source: www.history.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৪) The computer jargon - WWWW, stands for -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
One of the first indexing programs. It was developed in 1994 by Oliver McBryan and was used to catalogue content on the World Wide Web.
Many of the original ideas behind this program have survived in more modern Worms currently found on the Internet.
It is sometimes confused with the Internet worm, a virus which was unleashed into the Internet in the 1980s.
Source: www.oxfordreference.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৫) HTML is used to create -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
A web page or webpage is a document, commonly written in HTML, that is viewed in an Internet browser.
web pages frequently contain hypertext links that allow related pages to be retrieved.
HTML is the markup language for encoding Web pages.
It was designed by the British scientist Sir Tim Berners-Lee at the CERN nuclear physics.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৬) A computer on the internet are identified by -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
IP address, in full Internet Protocol address, Number that uniquely identifies each computer on the Internet.
A computer’s IP address may be permanently assigned or supplied each time that it connects to the Internet by an Internet service provider.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৭) A ------ shares hardware, software and data among authorized users.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Computer network, two or more computers that are connected with one another for the purpose of communicating data electronically.
Besides physically connecting computer and communication devices,
a network system serves the important function of establishing a cohesive architecture
that allows a variety of equipment types to transfer information in a near-seamless fashion.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৮) The process of removing unwanted part of an image is called -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Crop/cropping
Meaning: Remove part of (a photograph or other image) in order to produce a better picture or to fit a given space.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৯) The space left between the margin and the start of a paragraph is called-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
An indentation is a space at the beginning of a line of writing when it starts further away from the edge of the paper than all the other lines.
Source: Collins Dictionary.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১০) Text-styling feature of MS word is -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
WordArt is a quick way to make text stand out with special effects.
You begin by picking a WordArt style from the WordArt gallery on the Insert tab,
and then customize the text as you wish.
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১১) A number of letters that appears little above the normal text are called -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
A superscript or subscript is a number, figure, symbol, or
indicator that is smaller than the normal line of type and is set slightly above it (superscript) or below it (subscript).
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১২) In MS Word you can force a page break -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option1: ক) By positioning your cursor at the appropriate place and pressing the F1 key
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option2: খ) By using the Insert/Section break on the Insert tab
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option3: গ) By positioning your cursor at the appropriate place and pressing Ctrl+Enter
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option4: ঘ) By changing the font size of your document
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Step by step instructions to set page breaks in Microsoft Word:

To insert a manual page break, click into the document at the place you want the page break to occur, before an automatic break.
- Press the “Ctrl” + “Enter” keys on your keyboard.

Alternatively,
- Click the “Layout” tab in the Ribbon and click the “Breaks” drop-down button.
Then choose the “Page” option from the drop-down menu.
To insert a section break that creates a new section in your document, clicks the “Layout” tab of the Ribbon.
Then click the “Breaks” drop-down button in the “Page Setup” button group.
Then choose one of the following options from the “Section Breaks” section.
“Next Page,” will insert a page break and create two separate sections of the document.
“Continuous,” will insert a break but continue the next section on the same page.
“Odd Page” or “Even Page” will place a section break and then continue the next section on the next odd or even-numbered page.
To delete page breaks you have added to your document, ensure that you can view non-printing characters.
Click into the dotted line containing the term “Page Break” and press the “Delete” key on your keyboard.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৩) How to use Format Painter multiple times?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option1: ক) By Click on Lock Format Painter Icon
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option2: খ) By Double Click on the Format Painter Icon
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option3: গ) By Selecting Edit → Format Painter → Multiple Use
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option4: ঘ) Format Painter cannot be used multiple times
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
To change the format of multiple selections in your document, you must first double-click Format Painter.
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৪) Which of the following is not on the Home ribbon?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Home Ribbon means home tab.
The Home tab is the default tab in Microsoft Word.
It has five groups of related commands -
- Clipboard, Font, Paragraph, Styles and Editing. It helps you change document settings like font size, adding bullets, adjusting styles and many other common features.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৫) We can remove/hide the border of a shape by selecting -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Shape Outline lets you choose the color, thickness, or style of the outside border of a text box, shape, or SmartArt graphic.
By setting the border to No Outline, you remove the border altogether.
Source: www.support.mocrosoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৬) World Wide Web was proposed by -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Sir Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989.
Sir Tim is the Director of the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C),
a Web standards organization founded in 1994 which develops interoperable technologies (specifications, guidelines, software, and tools) to lead the Web to its full potential.
He is a Director of the World Wide Web Foundation which was launched in 2009 to coordinate efforts to further the potential of the Web to benefit humanity.
Source: www.w3.org

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৭) Benefits of Email are -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
E-mail, in full electronic mail, messages transmitted and received by digital computers through a network.
Large corporations and institutions use e-mail systems as an important communication link between employees and other people allowed on their networks.
Email is also available on major public online and bulletin board systems, many of which maintain free or low-cost global communication networks.
Email reduces communication costs, ensures quick communication and keeps the record of the information.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৮) Which among the following is a search engine?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
পিপীলিকা বাংলাদেশ থেকে তৈরিকৃত এবং নিয়ন্ত্রিত একটি ইন্টারনেটভিত্তিক অনুসন্ধান (সার্চ) ইঞ্জিন।
এটি বাংলাদেশের প্রথম অনুসন্ধান ইঞ্জিন, যেখানে বাংলা এবং ইংরেজি - উভয় ভাষায় তথ্য পাওয়ার সুবিধা রয়েছে।
সিলেটের শাহজালাল বিজ্ঞান ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কম্পিউটার বিজ্ঞান ও প্রকৌশল বিভাগের অধ্যাপক মুহম্মদ জাফর ইকবালের তত্ত্বাবধানে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক মো. রুহুল আমিনের নেতৃত্বে শাবিপ্রবির শিক্ষার্থীদের দ্বারা এটি চালু হয়। বর্তমানে পরীক্ষামূলকভাবে পরিচালিত হচ্ছে পিপীলিকা।
১৩ এপ্রিল ২০১৩ সালে এটি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে উদ্বোধন করা হয়।

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ১৯) In MS Excel, which of the following commands is used to close Excel?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Ctrl+W is the command is used to close Excel.
Other important shortcut commands are:
Ctrl + O is the command is used to open a workbook
Ctrl + V is the command is used to paste
Ctrl + Z is the command is used to undo.
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২০) TCP stands for -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
TCP, in full Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol, standard Internet communications protocols that allow digital computers to communicate over long distances.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২১) IPv4 address__ long.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
‘IP’ stands for ‘Internet Protocol’.
There are two versions of IP that currently coexist in the global Internet:
IP version 4 (IPv4) and IP version 6 (IPv6).
IP addresses are made up of binary values and drive the routing of all data over the Internet.
IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long, and IPv6 addresses 128 bits long.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২২) NAT stands for -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Network Address Translation (NAT) is designed for IP address conservation.
It enables private IP networks that use unregistered IP addresses to connect to the Internet.
NAT operates on a router, usually connecting two networks together, and translates the private (not globally unique) addresses in the internal network into legal addresses, before packets are forwarded to another network.
Source: www.cisco.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৩) History panel in a browser is used to -
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option1: ক) displays the URL of the pages visited
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Browsing history is the list of sites you've visited that are shown in the History menu, the Library window's History list and the address bar autocomplete list.
www.support.mozilla.org

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৪) While browsing the internet, which of the following keys is used for the full-screen view?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
A very common shortcut, particularly for browsers, is the F11 key.
It can take your screen into and out of full-screen mode quickly and easily.
Source: www.support.google.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৫) Which of the following is a common name for the crime of stealing password?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Spoofing is a type of scam in which criminals attempt to obtain someone's personal information by pretending to be a legitimate business, a neighbor, or some other innocent party.
There are several kinds of spoofing, including email spoofing, text message spoofing, caller ID spoofing, and URL and GPS spoofing.
In short, if there's a form of online communication, spoofers are trying to scam their way into it—and into your identity and your assets.
www.investopedia.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৬) In MS Word _____ option is used to change the width of a column to the contents of a table automatically.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Automatically adjust your table or columns to fit the size of your content by using the AutoFit button.Select your table.
To adjust column width automatically, click AutoFit Contents.
To adjust table width automatically, click AutoFit Window.
Source: www.support.microsoft.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৭) The main page of the Web site refers to ________.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Homepage:
Meaning: The introductory page of a website, typically serving as a table of contents for the site.
A home page is the default or front page of a site.
It is the first page that visitors see when they load a URL.
Web managers can control the home page as a way of directing the user experience.
Source: Oxford Dictionary & www.techopedia.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৮) A device that converts a computer's digital data over telephone lines to an analog signal is called ______.
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Modem, (from modulator/demodulator), any of a class of electronic devices that
convert digital data signals into modulated analog signals suitable for transmission over analog telecommunications circuits.
A modem also receives modulated signals and demodulates them, recovering the digital signal for use by the data equipment.
Source: www.britannica.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ২৯) Free of cost repair of software bug available at the Internet is called
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
A patch is a software update comprising code inserted (or patched) into the code of an executable program.
Typically, a patch is installed into an existing software program.
Patches are often temporary fixes between full releases of a software package.

Patches may do any of the following:
Fix a software bug
Install new drivers
Address new security vulnerabilities
Address software stability issues
Upgrade the software

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: ৩০) In MS word, which of the following commands is used to center the text?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Some important shortcuts for MS Word:
Ctrl+C = Copy the selected content to the Clipboard.
Ctrl+E = Center the text.
Ctrl+Z = Undo the previous action.
Ctrl+Y = Redo the previous action, if possible.
Ctrl+Alt+S = Split the document window.
Alt+Shift+C or Ctrl+Alt+S = Remove the document window split.
Source: Microsoft Website (support).
